remarks: Nestled on a peaceful street just moments from Greenwich Avenue, this beautifully renovated one-bedroom, one-bathroom apartment offers modern comfort in a prime location. Updated in 2017, the stylish interior features a sleek stainless steel and granite kitchen, central air conditioning, gleaming hardwood floors, and abundant natural light. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a spacious walk-in closet, a convenient office nook, and an inviting private balcony. Enjoy the ease of in-unit laundry, with on-street parking available. A perfect blend of charm and convenience in the heart of Greenwich!
